Definition: from a compound of G575 and G5530; the act of using up, i.e. consumption:--using.
BiblicalUsage: Once, about man-made religion. Paul dismisses rules about food and touch that perish with the using — commands and doctrines of men, not of God — things that wear out in the very act of being used.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for what is used up carries its own verdict: a religion built on such rules perishes with them.
